scope: Real local Web HTTP/SSE, DeepSeek and read-only synthetic MySQL; in-memory SQLite history. No browser/QQ/commercial acceptance.
privacy: Only synthetic questions/business records and redacted evidence. No credentials, cookies, session capabilities, real user messages or full local logs.

command.exitMeaning: Exit 1 records live interruption/global unknown-usage stop; it does not invalidate the separately passed deterministic code checks.

verification.comparedDatabaseScope: Before/after the only attempted turn: four planned orders with coupon/payment/refund facts, customer A recent-order list and eight knowledge rows. SELECT-only actual grants. Remaining five turns have no per-turn snapshots.
verification.sqliteRecovery: Separate local faux check used a real temporary SQLite file across close/reopen; live used in-memory history.
verification.mainChecksScope: Same repaired source transferred to main; existing playwright-core package/lock overlay retained. Main atomic/SSE/history/validate all exit0, separate from the frozen-lock live batch.

usage.priceSource: Frozen Pi catalog estimate, not provider invoice; unknown total is not filled with zero.

summary.scoreInterpretation: Complete denominator retained. Zero assessable answers is neither 0% semantic accuracy nor successful no-leak streaming.

failures.observed: Second model step has stopReason=error, interrupted production ledger and null usage/cost. Global guard stopped at unknown_provider_usage_or_cost; request aborted before final Reply.
failures.unknown: Original SDK/provider error message was not retained by existing capture; exact upstream cause and billed cost are unknown.
failures.impact: No completed new answer; switching turns and same-order follow-up were not exercised.
failures.decision: Stop and retain all six planned rows; no retry, repair-live rerun or extra setup questions.

engineeringDevelopmentFailures.originalLeak: Atomic and Web faux tests reproduced old-order content before repair.
reviewRegressions: Natural Agent list_orders cards initially suppressed
Mixed same-turn list then detail could retain old cards
Explicit B with list-only A+B needed distinction from order selection
engineeringDevelopmentFailures.preservedChecks: Atomic red/green logs for all three list boundaries and original leak; stream red for original leak/list regression, green-only for two later boundaries after concurrent production fix. All actual exits retained.
testAuthoringFailures: Mixed-history no-ID test initially expected a B answer instead of scope clarification
Temporary TypeScript assertion/narrowing and beforeList type-annotation errors; logs preserved

channelInterpretation.actualWebFinalSource: SSE result.reply and receipt.reply, full text plus order cards/evidence IDs
channelInterpretation.noDeltaMeaning: No completed answer, so absence of delta is not a successful order-switch or streaming acceptance.
channelInterpretation.emptyTraceCheck: transport.real-delta=true only checks that sent deltas came from native output; with no sent deltas this is vacuously true and does not show streaming completion.
